Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE LIV OF 1979
ORDINANCE LIV OF 1979
REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1979
An Ordinance further to amend the Representation of the People Act,
1976
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 8th October, 1979]
No. F.17(1)/79‑Pub.‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑(1) This Ordinance may be
called the Representation of the People (Second Amendment) Ordinance, 1979.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Representation of the People Second Amendment Ordinance 1979
sections.description:
Insertion of new section 11-A, Act LXXXV of 1976

ORDINANCE LIV OF 1979
ORDINANCE LIV OF 1979
REPRESENTATION OF THE PEOPLE (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1979
An Ordinance further to amend the Representation of the People Act,
1976
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 8th October, 1979]
No. F.17(1)/79‑Pub.‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :‑
2. Insertion of new section 11-A, Act LXXXV of 1976.‑In the
Represen tation of the People Act, 1976 (LXXXV of 1976), after section 11, the
following new section shall be inserted, namely:
"11‑A. Alteration in election programme.‑Notwithstanding
anything contained in section 11, the Commission may, at any time after the
issue of a notification under subsection (1) of that section, make such
alterations in the programme announced in that notification for the different
stages of the election as may, in its opinion, be necessary.".
